mgen-05-c1.text: Martin Jinek, Krzysztof Chylinski, Ines Fonfara, Michael Hauer, Jennifer A. Doudna, Emmanuelle Charpentier (2012). A programmable dual-RNA-guided DNA endonuclease in adaptive bacterial immunity. Science (New York, N.Y.).
mgen-05-c1.quote: The dual-tracrRNA:crRNA, when engineered as a single RNA chimera, also directs sequence-specific Cas9 dsDNA cleavage.
mgen-05-c1.claim: For genome editing, Streptococcus pyogenes Cas9 (SpCas9) became dominant after Jinek et al. (2012) fused crRNA + tracrRNA into a single sgRNA.

mgen-01-c2.text: Suhas S. P. Rao, Su-Chen Huang, Brian Glenn St Hilaire, Jesse M. Engreitz, Elizabeth M. Perez, Kyong-Rim Kieffer-Kwon, Adrian L. Sanborn, Sarah E. Johnstone, Gavin D. Bascom, Ivan D. Bochkov, Xingfan Huang, Muhammad S. Shamim, Jaeweon Shin, Douglass Turner, Ziyi Ye, Arina D. Omer, James T. Robinson, Tamar Schlick, Bradley E. Bernstein, Rafael Casellas, Eric S. Lander, Erez Lieberman Aiden (2017). Cohesin Loss Eliminates All Loop Domains. Cell.
mgen-01-c2.quote: All loop domains are eliminated, but neither compartment domains nor histone marks are affected.
mgen-01-c2.claim: Acute auxin-induced degradation of cohesin (Rao et al., 2017) eliminates all loop domains within hours but leaves compartments intact, which shows the two are mechanistically distinct.

mgen-05-c3.text: Andrew V. Anzalone, Peyton B. Randolph, Jessie R. Davis, Alexander A. Sousa, Luke W. Koblan, Jonathan M. Levy, Peter J. Chen, Christopher Wilson, Gregory A. Newby, Aditya Raguram, David R. Liu (2019). Search-and-replace genome editing without double-strand breaks or donor DNA. Nature.
mgen-05-c3.quote: including targeted insertions, deletions, and all 12 types of point mutation
mgen-05-c3.claim: Prime editing (Anzalone et al., 2019) extends scope to all 12 substitutions plus small indels.
